summary: The agent ran plan.md with subagent-driven development. Auto-compaction happened 11 times, both before Task 1 and between tasks. After each one, the agent re-read its skill, ledger and git log, then picked the loop back up. It ran implement → review for each of the four tasks in order, then a final whole-branch review, and finished in the finishing-a-development-branch step. I answered "Keep the branch as-is" and it left the branch as it was. npm test passes 59/59.
reasoning: I checked all four criteria against files on disk, npm test output, git log and the session/subagent JSONL timestamps. The controller kept the implement → review loop going in order through many compactions, ran the final review, and ended in the finishing step.

observations.description: Compaction happened far more often than the story suggests. The main log has 11 compact boundaries (22 entries, logged in pairs), from 22:43 to 23:02, and the first came during setup, before Task 1 was dispatched. The controller kept its loop through every one, saying things like 'Re-reading the ledger, git log, and the full skill text', but the test isn't the 'one compaction after the first task' case the story describes.

The controller asked one multi-question AskUserQuestion: what to do about the unused PASSAGE constants, behaviours that have no tests, and the missing 270-word test. Because it was a picker with options, I couldn't type the scripted 'Proceed as you recommend.' word for word. I chose the (Recommended) option for every question, which means the same thing.

At finish, the agent detached HEAD at 4d9c095 ('released the plan's lease on the branch') even though the user chose 'Keep the branch as-is'. A user might be surprised to end up in detached HEAD rather than on feature/textstats. The agent did say how to get back (git switch feature/textstats).

The finishing message included a notice that codex-plugin-cc is not installed, with install commands. That's noise for a user who didn't ask for it. The wording 'this review will run without an additional Codex review' also showed up after the review had already finished.
Each task review subagent ran very briefly, about 11–15 seconds (e.g. Review T3 22:56:42–22:56:54). The reviews did happen, but it's worth checking how thorough they were.

During startup, Claude Code showed a prompt saying 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' and offering to update to Opus 5.5, even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No. The banner then showed Opus 5.5. The default selection on both the trust dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog is 'No, exit'. On my first launch an extra Enter hit 'No, exit' and closed Claude, so I relaunched (my own mistake, but an easy trap).

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each with a test file, committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. The test/ folder has wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js. git log shows 6ae97c3 feat: add wordCount, 9b87b03 sentenceCount, e5f3bd4 topWords, 4d9c095 readingTimeMinutes. npm test: `ℹ tests 59 ℹ pass 59 ℹ fail 0`. git status is clean.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Start/end times from the subagent logs: Impl T1 22:47:38–22:48:09, Review T1 22:48:47–22:49:02, Impl T2 22:52:30–22:52:54, Review T2 22:53:36–22:53:51, Impl T3 22:55:17, Review T3 22:56:42–22:56:54, Impl T4 22:58:08, Review T4 22:59:27–22:59:38. Each review ended before the next implementer was dispatched.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Main log: `2026-11-12T23:01:31Z Agent Final whole-branch code review`, after Review T4. That subagent ran 23:01:31–23:02:18. Screen: 'The final review of the whole branch against main (a4ad960..4d9c095) found nothing and called it ready to merge.'

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Main log: `23:03:09Z Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch`. The screen showed the options '1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is'. I replied 'Keep the branch as-is', and the agent answered 'I've left feature/textstats as it was at 4d9c095: nothing merged, nothing pushed.'
